Hi Julie —

Great — thanks for checking. Quick answers below so you can proceed: 

- Arrival window: AM arrival preferred. Aim for landing between 9:00–11:30am on Jul 24 so the team has time to check into the venue and run a quick pre-brief.
- Connection time: please avoid sub-60 minute connections; 75–90 minutes preferred minimum for domestic itineraries.
- Seats: prioritize aisle seats for our presenters (Ben and myself); the rest of the team prefers window. Extra legroom is fine if within moderate fare difference (we'll approve up to +$120 per ticket).
- Carrier/fare: economy flexible (refundable/change allowed) is preferred for internal reimbursements. If business-class is required due to schedule constraints, please flag and we'll escalate approval.

Ben — can you confirm budget hold for up to $480 incremental (four seats) in case upgrades are necessary? Marissa — I'll need the PO code to pass to SableTech travel.

If you want us to select from the two flight options Julie listed, please pick the earlier AM landing and hold the seats for 24 hours.

Thanks,
Logan
